methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The purpose of this paper is to identify main success factors for the effective implementation, operation and certification of an energy management system (EnMS) in accordance with ISO 50001

stage1.ineligibility_reason: The paper surveys organisational success factors for implementing an EnMS but does not identify or characterise an EnPI/EnB measurement model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: For that reason a survey ( Jochem et al., 2013) among already certified German companies has been conducted focussing on organizational, teambuilding and technical aspects.

stage1.notes: Cross-sectional EnMS implementation survey; mentions indicators only incidentally and provides no EnPI/EnB model.
